scenario: Diego accrued 200 days of unlawful presence in total. Of those, 150 days occurred while he was 17 years old, and the remaining 50 days occurred after he turned 18. He then departed.
policy: General rule: An applicant who has been unlawfully present for more than 180 days and then departs triggers a 3-year bar to readmission. Override: Notwithstanding the general rule, time spent unlawfully present while under the age of 18 does not count toward the 180 days.
question: Is Diego subject to the 3-year bar to readmission?
